title: Maja Bjeljac — one extra-wide face at two extreme sizes
note: Druk Wide Bold (Commercial Type) does nearly everything: the MAJA BJELJAC wordmark (about 21px, caps), the nav (12.7px caps) and the big lowercase category labels set over photos (37–63px, tight leading). Captions, credits and years are tiny Inconsolata (11–14px). The chrome is only #000 / #222 on #FFFFFF or #FFFAFA, so the saturated, film-graded photos bring all the colour. Free stand-ins: Archivo at wdth 125 / wght 800 for Druk Wide, Inconsolata as is. Worth reusing: one wide heavy face at two extreme sizes, lowercase for the big labels, and colour only from the work.
